welcome.title: Wino Pay
welcome.subtitle: Fast, clear, and easy crypto checkout.

connect_wallet.title: Connect wallet
connect_wallet.subtitle: Connect a wallet to start. You keep the keys — Wino never takes custody.
connect_wallet.terms_link: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Risk Disclosure

connecting.title: Connecting
connecting.subtitle: Approve the connection request in your wallet.
connecting.helper: This may take up to 90 seconds.

timeout.title: Connection timed out
timeout.subtitle: Could not connect to the wallet service. This may be caused by network restrictions or unstable connection. Try using a VPN or switching networks.
timeout.tip: Tip: Make sure you have a stable internet connection

error.title: Connection failed
error.subtitle: Could not establish connection. Check your internet, try a VPN, or switch to a different network.

session_expired.title: Session expired
session_expired.subtitle: Your wallet connection expired. Please reconnect to continue.

review_profile.title: Review Business profile
review_profile.subtitle: Check how your business will appear to customers during checkout.

payment_methods.subtitle_setup: If you're not sure, enable more options — it increases the chance customers can pay.
payment_methods.subtitle_settings: Enable payment methods for your customers
payment_methods.disclaimer: Crypto payments are irreversible. Tips and refunds aren't automated — refunds must be sent back manually as a new transaction.

currency_setup.title: Select balance currency
currency_setup.subtitle: Pick a fiat currency to display totals, rates, and analytics. Clients still pay in stablecoins.
currency_setup.disclaimer: Rates are shown for reference only. The underlying amount and settlement are USD-based and recorded on-chain.

tron_connect.title: Connect Tron wallet
tron_connect.subtitle: Paste your TRON wallet address to receive TRC20 payments
tron_connect.placeholder: Paste your TRON address (starts with T)
tron_connect.warning: Make sure you enter the correct TRON address. Payments sent to wrong addresses cannot be recovered.

all_set.title: All set
all_set.subtitle: With no banks. With no custody.

business_profile.title: Enter Business info
business_profile.subtitle: Your business name and logo may be displayed to customers and may appear in payment records. Make sure it's correct.

dashboard.no_transactions_subtitle: Your received payments will appear here
dashboard.logout_subtitle: This will clear all local data including your wallet keys.

pos.disclaimer: Wino cannot reverse or refund transactions.
pos.no_methods_hint: Connect a wallet and enable payment methods in Settings.
pos.helper_text: Estimated total in local currency shown for reference only – customers pay in stablecoins. Always verify the network and amount.
pos.revoke_subtitle: Are you sure you want to cancel this payment? Customer may have already sent funds.
pos.blocked_subtitle: You have an active payment that must be completed or canceled first.
pos.cancel_subtitle: This payment is still pending. Canceling will stop detection and the customer will need to scan a new QR code.
pos.detection_stopped_after: Background detection has stopped after {minutes} minutes.
pos.check_wallet_manually: If the customer made a payment, check your wallet manually.

qr.bad_connection_desc: We can't verify this payment right now. Don't accept screenshots — only confirm payment when it appears as Paid.
qr.deadline_passed_desc: The 15-minute deadline has passed, but payment detection is still running in case the transaction was sent before the deadline.

expired.title: Invoice expired
expired.subtitle: The invoice has expired.
expired.helper: Create a new invoice to continue.

soft_expire.title: Payment timeout
soft_expire.helper: The customer may still be completing the transaction. Would you like to wait longer?

check_details.title: Check refund details
check_details.subtitle: Check the amount and destination before sending the refund. Refunds are processed as a new payment.

refund.disclaimer: Refunds are sent as a new transaction. Once sent, it can't be reversed.

success.title: Refund sent
success.subtitle: It may take some time to reflect in the recipient's wallet

failed.title: Refund failed
failed.subtitle: Something went wrong while processing the refund

manual.title: Manual refund
manual.subtitle: Send this refund manually from your wallet app (TronLink, OKX, etc). Copy the address and amount below.

redirect.title: Redirecting
redirect.subtitle: Please sign transaction in wallet to send refund

business_info.title: Business info
business_info.subtitle: Manage how your business appears during checkout.

language_select.title: Select language
language_select.subtitle: Choose your preferred language for the app interface.

appearance.subtitle: Choose how the app looks on your device.

logout.title: Logout?
logout.subtitle: Are you sure you want to log out from Wino Pay?

update.title: Update required
update.subtitle:
A new version of Wino Pay is available.
Update to continue using all features.
update.waiting_permission: Please enable installation from this source and return to the app

transaction.refund_sent_success: The refund has been sent successfully.
transaction.status_canceled_desc: This invoice was manually cancelled before payment was received.
transaction.status_expired_desc: Expired at 14:32. Checking for late payment...
transaction.footer_helper: Wino does not custody funds and cannot reverse transactions. Refunds, if any, are sent manually as a new transaction.
